charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10005
EEOC Office: Atlanta District Office
Charging Party: Kendall Foster
City/State: Denver, CO
Respondent: Oakridge Plumbing Co.
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Disability, Retaliation, Sex
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 11/23/2025 Latest 03/19/2026
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Oakridge Plumbing Co beginning before November 23, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about November 23, 2025 and continued through March 19, 2026.
2. On or about March 19, 2026, I was discharged from my position.
3. Throughout this period I was subjected to harassment by my supervisor, including repeated
remarks about my sex that made it difficult to do my job.
4. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my disability and retaliation and
sex, in violation of applicable federal law.
